Hideout — run unfamiliar developer tools inside an inspectable local VM.

Start here:
  1. hideout setup
  2. hideout doctor
  3. cd /path/to/project
     hideout run -- git status --short

While it runs:
  hideout tui
  hideout activity summary

Common tasks:
  Proxy or DNS:      hideout help connect
  Stop or delete VM: hideout help stop
  Browser console:   hideout ui

Find a command:
  hideout help <command>
  hideout help search <word>
  hideout help all  (compatibility alias: hideout help --all)

Boundary: macOS arm64 prerelease; the selected project is writable; direct networking does not hide your network origin.
